source.description: Anatomy reconstructed from the Virtual Worm reference atlas; c302 neurites converted from Virtual Worm. Cuticle and organ contours are sagittal projections. Atlas anatomy is not an optical recording of the simulated individual.
source.coordinates: Dimensionless body-length units. x from anterior (0) to posterior (1); y from source-VRML z, z from source-VRML x. Both radial coordinates recentered using cuticle cross-sections before normalization.
